member.name: OdooContext
member.summary: Odoo context - key/value settings sent with a request, e.g. language (lang), timezone (tz), company (allowed_company_ids) or active_test = false to include archived records. Properties are shortcuts for common keys; any other key can be set as in a dictionary. Setting a property to null removes an existing key.

member.name: Language
member.summary: Language of translatable fields (lang), e.g. en_US, pl_PL. The language must be installed in Odoo.

member.name: Timezone
member.summary: User timezone (tz), e.g. Europe/Warsaw. Used by Odoo for reports and date defaults - datetimes are still returned in UTC.

member.name: Tag
member.summary: Value of the tag key - used by some Odoo actions.

member.name: ActiveModel
member.summary: Model name in the active_model key - needed by some wizards and actions.

member.name: DefaultIsCompany
member.summary: Default value of is_company for created partners (default_is_company).

member.name: ForceCompany
member.summary: Company id in force_company - used by Odoo 12 and older for company dependent fields. Odoo 13+ ignores it; use instead.

member.name: AllowedCompanyId
member.summary: Company used by the request (allowed_company_ids, Odoo 13+): company dependent fields and new records use this company. The user must have access to it.

member.name: ctor.LanguageTimezone
member.summary: Creates context with given language and timezone.

member.name: ctor.Dictionary
member.summary: Creates context with values copied from a dictionary. Null creates empty context.

member.name: ctor.Merge
member.summary: Creates context by merging given contexts - later ones override earlier values. Null contexts are ignored.
